description: An independent simulated user receives an unresolved product-semantics question and must stop for human input instead of choosing an answer.

files.docs/product-decision.md:
# Pending decision

The default path may be relative to the caller working directory or the project root. Product has not approved either meaning.

initial_prompt: $superspec-explore change `choose-export-root`。调查导出默认路径到底应相对调用者当前目录还是项目根目录。现有需求源明确说明该产品语义尚未批准；不得替产品选择。形成当前可确认的调查结论。写入调查材料后必须再次执行 `superspec transition next --change choose-export-root`，让工作流返回正式 `ask_user`；不要绕过工作流自行用自然语言发明问题。每次 SuperSpec CLI 调用必须单独执行。

persona.risk_attitude: 没有明确批准的产品语义必须交给真人决定
